Bug_Details:
Using the standard getClassLoader() may not return the right class loader in a JEE context. Instead, go through the currentThread .
Noncompliant code example
ClassLoader cl = this.getClass().getClassLoader();  // Noncompliant
Compliant solution
ClassLoader cl = Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader();
Bug_Explanation: The code uses this.getClass().getClassLoader() to retrieve the class loader, which is not recommended in JEE applications. In such environments, it may not return the appropriate class loader. Instead, Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader() should be used.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls the showBug method of ClassLoaderBugExample, which uses this.getClass().getClassLoader(). This triggers the bug because in a JEE context, the class loader retrieved might not be the appropriate one.
